items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Billy Shaw? ... INTERVIEWEE: Billy Shaw, right. So Milt liked -- he liked Dizzy very much because he played trumpet. So, he was like the manager, so he -- his father sent him on the road with us.

ctx.x: And -- and Milt Shaw [phonetic sp.] was the son of -- of -- of Shaw.
